abnormalities.finding: Enlarged right hilum with a lobulated, well-defined rounded soft-tissue density (~3 cm) - hilar mass or hilar lymphadenopathy; denser and more lobulated than the contralateral hilum

Widened right paratracheal stripe / convex right paratracheal soft-tissue density above the hilum - possible right paratracheal lymphadenopathy (thymic remnant / SVC less likely given age but possible)
Mild left hilar prominence, mostly vascular in configuration - equivocal, could be normal for age
Low lung volumes with suboptimal inspiration and mild bronchovascular crowding at both bases (technical)

description_zh: 正面胸部X光，吸氣略不足並有輕度旋轉，未見任何導管、引流管、金屬夾或心律調節器，僅影像右上方見體外標記與標籤。右側肺門可見約3公分、邊緣分葉狀之軟組織密度增加，肺門輪廓明顯增大，需考慮肺門腫塊或淋巴結腫大；右側氣管旁條紋亦略增寬呈外凸，左側肺門僅輕度突出、多為血管影。雙側肺野未見明確浸潤、結節或肋膜積液，肋膈角銳利，無氣胸；心臟大小正常，氣管居中，骨骼與軟組織無明顯異常，左橫膈下可見正常胃泡。
